name: Hurler Ciarán

intro.text: Fancy a puck-about? Declan likes us to warm up the visitors. I'm the warm-up. The rest of the lads are the main course.

win: Good hit! Go on through. The boss is at the far end, and he's even louder than I am.
after: Hurling's the fastest field game in the world. I'm told. I've never beaten it to the ball.
